eligible_license.note: The root has a full EUPL-1.2 grant; README and the main plugin PHP header also declare GPL-2.0-or-later. Both are OSI-approved, but the exact dual-license scope needs owner clarification; bundled vendor-prefixed dependencies retain their own terms.

primary_evidence.note: README gives real plugin installation and use, and the main plugin file has version 0.0.1, but there is no tag/release, public official service page or municipal deployment tied to this plugin. It sends files to the external NLDoc service, which is not part of this repository.

product_identity: OWC Accessible Docs WordPress plugin (requires external NLDoc document-processing service)
agency: OpenWebconcept municipal collaboration; Yard Digital Agency (co-founder/implementation partner; exact commissioning municipality unverified)
license: EUPL-1.2 root grant; main plugin/README also say GPL-2.0-or-later (both eligible; scope expression unresolved)
family_note: Plugin code is source-available and installable, but the NLDoc document conversion/status platform is an external service and is not included or licensed by this repository. Do not imply the plugin alone provides document conversion.
status_note: Initial public commit is dated 2025-02-18 and contains plugin code plus EUPL text; main file declares 0.0.1 and GPL-2.0-or-later. Hold until an official municipal/OWC page identifies this exact plugin in use and owner confirms grants/dependency boundary.

decision_reason: Pacini-typing is a stable RIVM bioinformatics CLI application for bacterial gene/SNP detection, with versioned releases, Bioconda installation, extensive configuration and end-user documentation. The first substantive public code commit dated 2024-09-27 contains functional Python code and the AGPL-3 license; current RIVM publiccode conservatively identifies AGPL-3.0-only. The code grant is clear, with FASTA/reference/test data scoped separately.

government_provenance.note: The exact PublicCode manifest names the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) as copyright owner/agency; README identifies the IDS infectious-disease research department and RIVM commissioning context.

public_source.note: The public Python application, configuration, tests, setup files and current releases are available. It installs via Bioconda or from source.

eligible_license.note: The first substantive public code snapshot contains the full GNU AGPL version 3 text; current publiccode identifies AGPL-3.0-only. License scope is the RIVM application code; included reference/test FASTA and related biological data files may have separate data provenance/terms and are not claimed under AGPL here.

primary_evidence.note: First-party README provides actual command usage, configuration, installation (Bioconda/source), testing and intended Yersinia pestis/Vibrio cholerae use cases; current versioned release v3.1.1 is at https://github.com/RIVM-bioinformatics/Pacini-typing/releases/tag/v3.1.1.

product_identity: Pacini-typing CLI for bacterial DNA sequence and SNP detection/genotyping
agency: National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM), IDS department
license: AGPL-3.0-only for application code; sequence/reference/test-data assets not assumed covered
family_note: Standalone scientific CLI. Core dependencies BLAST/KMA and user/reference databases are external; bundled FASTA/test fixtures have distinct data provenance and should not be represented as software source under the AGPL without separate rights review.
status_note: The earlier 2024-09-27 commit 4a602c1 contained only LICENSE/README/.gitignore; the substantive 2024-09-27 commit cf538049 is the first inspected tree with Pacini-typing.py, main.py and AGPL text. Current release v3.1.1 is dated 2026-05-20 and Bioconda provides install guidance.
